mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have 83 degree temperatures and clear skies at Verona City Hall, under a waning crescent moon, with an elevated air quality index of 54.
The city of Verona maintains a partnership with AECOM Inc. for ongoing engineering services, with detailed reports regularly presented to the city council to keep our local infrastructure updated.
We have a full weekend of fun starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market tomorrow.
In a recent report, an officer conducted a traffic stop on Thursday, July 30, that resulted in the driver being arrested for an O W I and cited for suspended vehicle registration.
